candidates.statement: Redis reserve_inventory operations time out (~2s), causing inventory POST /v1/reservations to return 503, order POST /v1/orders to fail with transport ReadTimeout, and gateway POST /v1/checkout to return 502 across all correlated traces.
candidates.uncertainty: No redis-side metrics/logs; root cause of the redis timeout (saturation, network, config) is not established.

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timeouts propagating to inventory 503, order transport ReadTimeout, and gateway 502 on /v1/checkout; logs and metrics corroborate ~2s checkout latency and 502s. Topology confirms gateway->order->inventory->redis path. Bounded candidate: redis-timeout.
missing_evidence: Redis service metrics/logs showing latency, saturation, or errors during the incident window
Inventory service logs confirming the redis dependency failure origin
